tour_blurb: And right at the top, Telegram Reception — a small, attentive desk that receives messages from outside via Telegram, hands them to the lobby for greeting, and carries replies back out. A modest floor with a long view, keeping the Tower in touch with friends beyond the building.
lessons_learned_for_next_agent: F165 sits in 'activating' until Ross pastes the BotFather token into vault/.env.telegram — do NOT read the vault file to inspect contents; only confirm the stub path exists. The floor proxies inbound DMs to F0 (greet/converse/close), so any F165 health check must also verify F0 endpoints are alive before declaring F165 healthy.

team_roster.role: owns floor: keeps room schema current, tracks worker headcount, stamps daily activity, escalates to Wren+Hermes
